description: Retrospective explanation of coordinate plans frozen before replay generation and training; exact JSON coordinates, not a new draw, are authoritative for reproduction.
uniform: Uniform XY samples over x [-0.06,0.06], y [-0.23,-0.11] metres.

selection: Each clip has ten predeclared candidates; try in listed order and retain first four successful contact-physics replays. All first four succeeded in each arm.
rng_note: The one-off coordinate-sampling RNG state is not captured in this sidecar. Simulator seeds and every exact XY coordinate are captured in the immutable selection JSONs.
